chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) he said:
Allah has never been worshipped with anything better than fulfilling the right of a believer.
ai.seo_question: What is the best form of worship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies fulfilling the rights of a fellow believer as the superior form of worship, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence that bridges the gap between individual piety and communal responsibility. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on *haqq al-nas* (rights of people) as a prerequisite for *haqq Allah* (rights of God), reflecting the holistic nature of devotion in the Ahl al-Bayt tradition. It serves as a theological foundation for social ethics, elevating interpersonal kindness to the level of primary acts of devotion.
